hero.kicker: Houda Hdili · Full-stack developer · DevOps focus
hero.title: Hi, I'm Houda
hero.lede: I'm Houda Hdili, a full-stack developer with a DevOps focus, trained at Zone01 Oujda. I build complete web apps with Go, Spring Boot, Next.js and Angular, then ship them with Docker and Kubernetes.

about.title: I learn by building, with peers instead of lectures
paragraphs: I study at Zone01 Oujda, a project-based school with no teachers and no lectures. Every skill on this page comes from a project: we read a specification, build it alone or in a small team, and other students review the work before it is validated.
Before Zone01, I earned a Bac in Mathematical Sciences B (French option). Maths gave me the habit of breaking a problem into small steps and checking each one, which is how I debug today.

I've completed the DevOps specialty, and I like knowing what happens under the hood. I've worked on an HTTP server written without any framework, a front-end mini-framework built from scratch and a Unix shell in Rust. [TODO: one or two sentences in your own words about what drives you]
